item.text: The module now uses `requests.get()` and `raise_for_status()`. Binary MARC and XML reads use response bytes; the text check uses decoded text. I’ve also changed the XML call sites to parse content bytes, since lxml treats a raw bytes argument to `etree.parse()` as a filename.
